mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tightening labor market that signals strong economic growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 5.0% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, or the correlation between UNRATE < 5.0% and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity and strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in INDPRO and HOUST does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, a decline in INDPRO does not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,050,000 units, it signals strong residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1050.0 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the correlation is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions and economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, a decline in UNRATE does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression is not significant (p>0.05).
